Method of Attack: Recording audio, stealing call logs/SMS/contacts and specific file types (PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, XLS, XLSX, TXT, JPG, JPEG, PNG)
Silencing notifications from security apps on Samsung, Xiaomi, and Huawei devices to operate silently
Reading notifications from messaging apps (WhatsApp, Facebook, Telegram, Instagram, Skype, Messenger, Viber) to steal incoming messages
Recording screen (video and picture), recording incoming and outgoing WhatsApp calls, making covert calls by creating a black screen overlay mimicking an inactive phone
Impacted Systems: Android devices from Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei
Attack Vector: Distributed through fake messaging apps like Threema, Telegram, WeMessage, and apps from unofficial Android stores such as DigitalApps
Concealed in installation files of fake or modified messaging apps
Fake download gate requiring a six-digit code to limit spread
Indicators of Compromise: Malware samples disguised as messaging apps 'WeMessage', 'Threema', 'Telegram', 'AndroidUpdate'
Presence in unofficial Android store DigitalApps
